description: P23: the Ogre King's fight, in its own frame (D aeolian, 104 BPM, twelve bars, 27.7 s; it shares no stem with the zone sets). Double-time taiko and a chromatic low-brass ostinato with the King's horn call; from phase 2 a string tremolo grinding a semitone above each chord's root. Enters after its one-bar intro stinger.
